activeQuestion.prompt: An unregistered viewer missed the first few minutes. What can they get today?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 一位未報名的觀眾錯過前幾分鐘，今天可以取得什麼？

options.whyZh: 錄影明天提供給已報名者，不是今天給訪客。

options.text: An individual repeat of the missed steps.
options.zh: 請講者為他重做錯過的步驟。
options.whyZh: 講者請晚到的人不要要求重做。
訪客今天可拿摘要，不能同時拿到明天才寄的錄影。
未報名者是訪客，今天能下載摘要；已報名者明天才會收到錄影。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 未報名者是訪客，今天能下載摘要；已報名者明天才會收到錄影。
activeQuestion.evidence: If you joined late, use the recording to catch up instead of asking us to repeat a step. Registered viewers get the recording tomorrow; guests can download the summary today.

vocabulary.note: 此處指未先報名的觀眾。

originalQuestion.prompt: When will participants' questions be answered?
originalQuestion.promptZh: 參加者的問題會在何時獲得回答？

options.whyZh: 下個月討論採購模組，當天問題會在示範後回答。

options.zh: 任何人進入說明會以前。
options.whyZh: 參加者在活動中提問，並非活動開始前已全部回答。
可隨時輸入問題，但回答時點是 after the demonstration；輸入與回答時間不同。

options.text: Immediately each time a message appears.
options.zh: 每次訊息出現時立刻回答。
options.whyZh: 主持人明確安排示範後集中回答，未承諾即時逐則回答。

originalQuestion.explanationZh: 可隨時輸入問題，但回答時點是 after the demonstration；輸入與回答時間不同。
originalQuestion.evidence: we will answer them after the demonstration.

group.title: An inventory webinar with a catch-up plan
group.titleZh: 庫存網路研討會與補課安排
group.passage:
Today we’ll set low-stock alerts and export a weekly summary. We’ll cover ordering next month.
If you joined late, use the recording to catch up instead of asking us to repeat a step. Registered viewers get the recording tomorrow; guests can download the summary today.
Use the practice file to follow along. If you only have company records, watch the demo without uploading anything.
group.passageZh:
今天會示範如何設定低庫存警示及匯出週報。下個月才會介紹訂購功能。
如果你晚到，請用錄影補看，不用請我們重做步驟。已報名的觀眾明天會收到錄影；訪客今天可下載摘要。
請用練習檔跟著操作。如果手邊只有公司資料，就只看示範，不要上傳任何檔案。
